briefing.headline: AMD slides 1.9% as tech stocks pull back
briefing.summary: All ten core tech giants posted losses, with AMD leading the decline at -1.9% and NVDA the only modest gainer at +0.2%. Broad market proxies QQQ, SPY and the mega‑cap indices also slipped, underscoring a uniform risk‑off tone. Small‑cap and speculative tokens such as FRMI rallied sharply, while many others (PSNY, SPCE, ZVRA) plunged over 15%. The breadth shows a dominant down‑side bias across the board.
